description: Get on-chain DEX liquidity data for fan tokens on Chiliz Chain. Returns pool TVL, depth, token reserves, and estimated slippage. Critical for agents that want to understand execution costs before trading on-chain.

limit.description: Max pools when no token is given (sorted by TVL). Default 25; pools_total reports the full count.

token.description: Token symbol (optional). If omitted, returns all pools sorted by TVL.

name: tokenintel_dex_liquidity
